newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar falls on low demand, fresh supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar falls on low demand, fresh supply.

text.p: Indian sugar prices extended losses on Monday on low consumer demand and fresh arrivals, dealers said.

Sugar supplies, through the public distribution system, were at comfortable levels which in turn cut sugar offtake from the open market. Millers remained active sellers in the local market due to an absence of fresh enquiries from outstation buyers.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 10/12 rupees to 1,213/1,250 rupees while M-30 slid by five rupees to 1,255/1,300 rupees. Sugar mill delivery remained quiet at 1,155/1,165 rupees amid limited activity. Sentiments remained quiet at the close.
